name: tb7_idle
description: TB7: idle inputs on all three lanes: open (driver removed, 1 Mohm to the common mode), terminated (VID = 0, 50 ohm source + 100 ohm termination), shorted (P = N), 7 VIC; terminated runs also drift the source +-100 mV slowly. v0: no failsafe guarantee, the held state is reported
